title: Deployment configuration
description: The file /deployment.json, which app reads at every start from the root of its origin, beside its signed build (section 4 of the deployment text). It holds no secret: every browser that opens app gets it.

format.description: The version of the format, the integer in deployment/VERSION.

api.description: The origin of api: a scheme, a host in lower case and perhaps a port, with no path, query, fragment or credentials; https, or http on a loopback host. That it is equal to its own origin, and that http needs app itself on a loopback host, are rules of reading (section 5).

signIn.description: The sign-in service and the parameters of its project.

service.description: The sign-in service: Firebase Auth. Another service is another adapter, in api and in app.

apiKey.description: The key of the Firebase web app, as the Firebase console gives it.

authDomain.description: The host of the Firebase sign-in pages, with no scheme and no path, such as example-project.firebaseapp.com.

projectId.description: The ID of the Firebase project.

appId.description: The ID of the Firebase web app.
